info.description:
# B2B Retailer app (تطبيق التاجر)

Generated **2026-11-03** from `route:list` + catalog. Live routes only.

| | |
|---|---|
| Requests | **59** |
| Environment | `docs/api/environments/retailer-android.postman_environment.json` |
| X-Client | `retailer-android` |
| Seed | public OTP → kind retailer — local code 0000 when bypass |

Import this file **and** the matching environment. `baseUrl` is the host only (no `/api/v1`).
Do not mix tokens across platform / channel / warehouse collections.

Contract briefs: `docs/DocsLast/retailer.md` · order flow: `docs/DocsLast/order-flow.md`

Regenerate: `php docs/api/generate-dashboard-postman.php`

|---|---|

| Name | فحص الصحة |

| | |
|---|---|
| Guard | `none` |
| Idempotency | n/a |
| X-Client | `retailer-android` |
| Name | انترو التطبيق |

Same singleton the platform back office edits (EP-AD-141A/B). No auth — first-run splash before OTP. Vacant store is enabled:false. Apps must not call /platform/content/intro or /channel/content/intro (wrong_guard). Targeting is ignored on first run (no zone yet). media_id is an opaque string, not a URL, until media upload exists.

Single source of truth (REQ-IN-07). Precedence stop-at-first-match (most specific wins; lists do not stack): retailer_price ← group_list ← zone_list ← qty_tier ← base_price. Clients must not send prices. gross is the sum of unit_price × qty (السعر). discount is the sum of line discounts (الخصم). subtotal is gross − discount (الإجمالي). All three are integers in minor units.
